message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>The global automobile market experiences quick changes in design preferences. In response to the demand shifts, manufacturers now try to apply new technologies to bring a novel design to market faster. In this paper, we introduce a novel AI application that performs a similarity verification task of wheel designs that aims to solve the real‐world problem. Through the deep metric learning approach, we empirically prove that the cross‐entropy loss does similar tasks as the pairwise losses do in the embedding space. On Jan 2022, we successfully transitioned the verification system to the wheel design process of Hyundai Motor Company's design team and shortened the verification time by 90% to a maximum of 10 min. With a few clicks, the designers at Hyundai Motor could take advantage of our verification system.</jats:p>
title: Application of deep metric learning in the verification process of wheel design similarity: Hyundai motor company case
